items.title: Agility chooses Nyobolt for ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
items.summary: Nyobolt is providing power technology for Digit 5 that enables Agility's humanoid to work up to 20 hours a day.The post Agility chooses Nyobolt for ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid appeared first on The Robot Report.
items.creator: The Robot Report Staff
